review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security has emerged as the leader in AI-powered email security, protecting organizations from sophisticated phishing, business email compromise (BEC), and account takeover attacks that bypass traditional email gateways.
review.abnormal-security.using.behaviora: Using behavioral AI, Abnormal builds a baseline of normal communication patterns for every user and detects anomalies that indicate attacks—even when emails contain no malicious links or attachments.
review.abnormal-security.the.api-based.a: The API-based architecture integrates seamlessly with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace without requiring MX record changes or inline deployment.
review.abnormal-security.learns.communic: Learns communication patterns to detect anomalous emails indicating attacks.
review.abnormal-security.industry-leadin: Industry-leading detection of business email compromise and impersonation.
review.abnormal-security.detects.comprom: Detects compromised accounts based on behavioral indicators.
review.abnormal-security.stops.vendor.em: Stops vendor email compromise and supply chain attacks.
review.abnormal-security.easy.deployment: Easy deployment via API—no MX record changes required.
review.abnormal-security.automatically.r: Automatically removes malicious emails from all inboxes.
review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security uses enterprise-focused pricing based on number of mailboxes and deployment scale:
Custom pricing per mailbox, typically starts at 1,000+ users
Pricing scales with number of protected email accounts
review.abnormal-security.all.features.in: All features included - no module-based upsells
review.abnormal-security.professional.se: Professional services available for deployment assistance
review.abnormal-security.typically.annua: Typically annual commitments with volume discounts
review.abnormal-security.pricing.justifi: Pricing justifies with prevented breach costs
review.abnormal-security.enterprise.orga: Enterprise Organizations: Large companies with 1,000+ mailboxes needing advanced email security
review.abnormal-security.financial.servi: Financial Services: Banks and financial institutions facing targeted BEC attacks
review.abnormal-security.healthcare.medi: Healthcare: Medical organizations protecting patient data from phishing
review.abnormal-security.professional.se: Professional Services: Law firms, consulting firms with high-value wire transfers
review.abnormal-security.manufacturing.c: Manufacturing: Companies vulnerable to vendor email compromise in supply chain
review.abnormal-security.m365google.work: M365/Google Workspace: Organizations using Microsoft or Google cloud email
review.abnormal-security.small.businesse: Small businesses under 100 users (pricing not economical)
review.abnormal-security.abnormal.uses.a: Abnormal uses API-based deployment connecting directly to Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. No MX record changes or mail flow modifications required. Deployment typically takes less than 30 minutes with minimal IT involvement.
review.abnormal-security.instead.of.sign: Instead of signature-based detection, Abnormal learns normal communication patterns for each user—who they email, writing style, timing, etc. It then detects anomalies indicating attacks, even when emails contain no malicious links or attachments.
review.abnormal-security.abnormal.typica: Abnormal typically works alongside existing SEGs (like Proofpoint or Mimecast) to catch sophisticated attacks they miss. Some organizations eventually replace their SEG, but most deploy Abnormal as an additional layer focused on advanced threats.
review.abnormal-security.abnormal.begins: Abnormal begins protecting immediately but improves detection accuracy during the first 30 days as it learns organizational communication patterns. Most value is realized within the first week of deployment.
review.abnormal-security.abnormal.has.on: Abnormal has one of the lowest false positive rates in the industry, typically under 0.1%. The behavioral AI approach means it understands context and catches real attacks while minimizing legitimate email blocking.
review.abnormal-security.abnormal.securi: Abnormal Security sets the standard for AI email security. Its behavioral approach catches sophisticated attacks that bypass traditional gateways. Essential for organizations facing advanced email threats.
